govde: LİMİT GLOBAL MARINE DENİZCİLİK ONARIM VE TEKNİK HİZMETLER SANAYİ VE TİCARET LİMİTED ŞİRKETİ
YATONET 360 Portal Terms of Use

Scope: These terms apply to yacht owners and their authorised representatives, insurance companies, Solution Partners, suppliers, salvage, towing and diving service providers, technical expertise and equipment rental providers, marinas, shipyards and haul-out operators, and the users they authorise, who use the YATONET 360 portal and mobile application (the "Portal") operated by LİMİT GLOBAL MARINE Denizcilik Onarım ve Teknik Hizmetler Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi ("LGM"). LGM staff use the Portal under the Staff Regulation. In case of discrepancy, the Turkish version prevails.
1. Definitions
Term
Meaning
User
A natural person who logs in to the Portal with an account opened in their own name
Organisation
The company or body on whose behalf the User acts
Contract
The service, framework or assignment contract between the Organisation or customer and LGM
File
The record of a request, damage or service relating to a yacht
2. Acceptance and Relationship with the Contract

The User reads and accepts these terms through YATONET 360 at first login; the date of acceptance and the version of the text are recorded. These terms govern the use of the Portal; the scope, price and timing of services and the responsibilities of the parties are set out in the Contract. If these terms conflict with the Contract, the Contract prevails.
3. Account and Security
Each User has a personal account; the account, password and verification code may not be shared. LGM never asks for your verification code.

Corporate user accounts are opened, changed and closed at the request of an authorised person of the Organisation and upon LGM's confirmation. The Organisation promptly notifies LGM of any user who leaves.
In addition to the password, an authenticator app code or an SMS code is required at login; the code may be requested again for approvals. Sessions with no activity for 30 minutes are closed.
The User immediately informs LGM of any unauthorised use of the account.
At first login the User selects the Portal language (Turkish or English); this preference can be changed later in the profile.
4. Authorisation and Visibility

The User sees only the information required by their role and by the File to which they are assigned. The identity of Solution Partners is not shown to the yacht owner or the insurance company. The User may not attempt to access information outside their authorisation; any information accessed by mistake is not used or shared and is reported to LGM.
5. Declarations and Approvals Given Through the Portal

Quotation approvals, scope change approvals, deliveries, reports and attendance and read-and-understood declarations are given through the Portal; no wet signature is required. Transactions for which the law requires a signature or a secure electronic signature are excluded.
Declarations and approvals are recorded with the user, date and time, text version and verification data and cannot be altered.

Organisations that are merchants accept that Portal records constitute an evidence agreement between them and LGM under Article 193 of the Turkish Code of Civil Procedure No. 6100; the right to prove otherwise is reserved. For individual yacht owners, Portal records constitute evidence; the individual yacht owner's right to prove otherwise by any means of evidence is reserved.
6. Uploaded Content
The User is responsible for ensuring that the photographs, documents and information uploaded are accurate and that they have the right to share them.

Uploaded content is used only for handling the relevant File, record keeping and legal obligations. Images of a yacht, person or File are not used for promotional purposes without the written permission of the person concerned.
Malware, unlawful content and personal data unrelated to the File may not be uploaded. The User does not upload special categories of personal data that are not necessary for the File.
7. Prohibited Use
The User may not:
use another person's account or impersonate another person,
extract data with automated tools, copy the Portal, reverse engineer it or attempt to bypass its security measures,
use Portal information for purposes other than the Contract, disclose it to third parties or establish business relations in breach of the non-circumvention provisions of the Contract,
send loads or content that would disrupt the operation of the Portal.
8. AI-Assisted Suggestions and Information-Only Data

The Portal may offer AI-assisted functions such as text summaries, classification and suggestions. These suggestions are not binding; decisions are made by the authorised person. Exchange rates shown in the Portal are for information only; the rate applied in the invoice is determined by the Contract and the invoice terms.
9. Service Continuity

LGM takes the necessary measures for the Portal to operate continuously and securely. Planned maintenance is announced in the Portal in advance wherever possible. In the event of an interruption, transactions continue through the backup communication channel set out in the Contract or notified by LGM. Service level commitments are set out only in the Contract.
10. Intellectual Property

The YATONET 360 software, design, data structure and content belong to LGM. The User is granted a non-transferable, non-exclusive right of use solely for the performance of the Contract and for its duration. Rights in content uploaded by the User remain with the User.
11. Personal Data

Personal data are processed under the privacy notice applicable to each user group: Yacht Owner Privacy Notice (KVKK-01), Solution Partner Authorised Persons and Personnel Privacy Notice (KVKK-03), Business Partner and Stakeholder Representatives Privacy Notice (KVKK-04) and Cookie Policy (KVKK-08). These texts are always available in the Portal.
12. Suspension and Closure of Accounts

LGM may suspend or close an account in the event of a breach of these terms, a security risk, termination of the Contract or at the Organisation's request; except in urgent security cases, the User is informed in advance. Closure of an account does not affect the retention of File records for the statutory retention periods.
13. Changes
LGM may update these terms. The current version is published in the Portal; in the case of material changes, the User is asked to accept the terms again at the next login.
14. Governing Law and Jurisdiction

These terms are governed by Turkish law. Where the parties are merchants and a jurisdiction agreement is legally permissible, Istanbul Anatolian Courts and Enforcement Offices have jurisdiction over disputes. Individual yacht owners' right to apply to consumer arbitration committees and consumer courts is reserved.
15. Contact

Questions and notices about the Portal may be sent through the Help tab in the Portal, the “Help | LGM Head Office” button available on every screen, or to the e-mail address portal@limitglobalmarine.com.tr.
